info.album: We Belong Together (Mimi's Late Night Valentine's Mix)

podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 2005, marking Mariah Carey's successful mid-decade return after a chart slump. It spent a "whopping 14 weeks at number one," demonstrating her renewed chart power. 2005 was a strong year for female pop divas, but "We Belong Together" was undeniable, becoming her only hit to ever claim the year-end crown. "We Belong Together spent a whopping 14 weeks at number one."

podcast.body: This song was the winner of the 2005 Billboard Song of the Summer. It is referred to as the "last great pure ballad winner of song of the summer" and dominated the Hot 100 for almost every week of the summer of 2005, totaling 14 weeks. Carey's lyrics invoked the "summer pastime of searching the radio dial for other songs about heartbreak." "We belong together. It commanded the hot 100 for almost every week of the summer of 2005, 14 weeks in all."
